meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: What taking part in a Friends of Animals competition costs, by route.

pricing.title: Pricing

items.perCompetition: Each competition shows its fee, or says Free, before you register.
items.school: Through a school, the school pays once for all its students.
items.self: On your own, a parent or guardian pays. An adult participant pays for themselves.
items.noExtras: There are no hidden charges, and we never charge to send artwork back.
items.donations: Donations are separate and optional. You never need to give to take part.

fees.title: Fees by route
fees.lead: Fees are in rupees. They are not set yet; each will appear here and on every competition page before registration opens.
fees.caption: Competition fees by participation route
fees.schoolWho: The school, once, for all its registered students
fees.selfWho: A parent or guardian, or the adult participant

set.title: How fees are set
set.body: Each competition sets its own fee for each route. A competition can also be free. The fee you see when you register is the fee you pay: if it changes later, your registration keeps the old price.

pay.title: How to pay
pay.body: Online payments go through Razorpay: UPI, cards and net banking from Indian banks. Schools can also pay offline by cheque, demand draft or bank transfer; the steps are shown when the school registers.

receipt.title: What you get
receipt.body: Every payment gets a fee acknowledgement by email. A fee acknowledgement isn't a donation receipt, and can't be used to claim tax relief.

gst.title: GST
gst.body: We don't issue GST invoices. The amount shown is the amount you pay.

switch.title: Changing route or school
switch.body: If a student moves from one school to another during a competition, no difference in fee is charged or refunded.

pricing.questions: Questions about a payment? Contact us
